extension.name: CodeTrack
extension.description: CodeTrack VS Code extension. Real-time programming activity and duration tracker.
config.title: CodeTrack
config.statusBarInfo.description: Select the duration window displayed in the status bar.
config.statusBarInfo.enum.today: Show today's code time since midnight
config.statusBarInfo.enum.24h: Show code time over the trailing 24 hours
config.serverEntrypoint.description: API server endpoint URL for reporting event data.
config.proxy.description: HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL for requests (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080). Defaults to VS Code or environment proxy.
config.displayLanguage.description: Select the display language for CodeTrack status and notifications.
config.trackingEnabled.description: Enable or disable programming activity tracking.
config.obfuscateFilePaths.description: Obfuscate relative file paths with SHA-256 hashes to protect proprietary file names.
